description: This file is a Markdown documentation outlining the design, API, operation, and hardware integration details of the 'CompositeInput' HAL interface for managing analog composite video inputs on a platform. It provides high-level specifications, interface details, event flow sequences, capabilities, discovery patterns, and state machine diagrams.

classes.name: IPortEventListener
classes.description: Interface for receiving connection, signal, and video mode change events for composite input ports.

classes.name: IPortTelemetryListener
classes.description: Interface for receiving telemetry metrics updates from composite input ports.

classes.name: PortCapabilities
classes.description: Details supported capabilities and properties for a specific port.

classes.name: Port
classes.description: Metadata describing a specific composite input port.

methods.name: getPlatformCapabilities
methods.description: Returns platform-wide capabilities such as supported features.

methods.name: getPortIds
methods.description: Returns list of available port IDs.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Retrieves the interface for a specific port by ID.

methods.name: getCapabilities
methods.description: Returns capabilities for a specific port.

methods.name: getPortInfo
methods.description: Returns metadata info about the port such as name and description.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Fetches the current value of a specified property.

methods.name: getPropertyMulti
methods.description: Batch fetch multiple properties for a port.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Activates or deactivates the port for video presentation.

methods.name: registerEventListener
methods.description: Registers an event callback for connection and signal changes.
